svg.aria-label: Lines of pull and lumbar movements: what lies behind, beside and in front of the axis — 拉力线与腰椎动作：在运动轴之后、之旁和之前的肌肉

text.aria-label: Lines of pull and lumbar movements: what lies behind, beside and in front of the axis — 拉力线与腰椎动作：在运动轴之后、之旁和之前的肌肉
text.tspan: Lines of pull and lumbar movements: what lies behind, beside and in front of the axis
拉力线与腰椎动作：在运动轴之后、之旁和之前的肌肉

text.aria-label: A. Right lateral view (anterior right): extension — A. 右侧面观（前方在右）：后伸
text.tspan: A. Right lateral view (anterior right): extension
A. 右侧面观（前方在右）：后伸
Erector spinae
竖脊肌
Multifidus
多裂肌
Psoas major
腰大肌

text.aria-label: Axis (schematic, near the disc) — 运动轴（示意，靠近椎间盘）
text.tspan: Axis (schematic, near the disc)
运动轴（示意，靠近椎间盘）

text.aria-label: B. Posterior view: lateral flexion — B. 后面观：侧屈
text.tspan: B. Posterior view: lateral flexion
B. 后面观：侧屈

text.aria-label: Quadratus lumborum: bends the trunk to its own side — 腰方肌：使躯干向同侧屈
text.tspan: Quadratus lumborum: bends the trunk to its own side
腰方肌：使躯干向同侧屈
Intertransversarii
横突间肌

text.aria-label: C. From above: rotation is blocked by the joints — C. 上面观：关节突关节限制旋转
text.tspan: C. From above: rotation is blocked by the joints
C. 上面观：关节突关节限制旋转

text.aria-label: Superior articular process of L4 — L4 上关节突
text.tspan: Superior articular process of L4
L4 上关节突

text.aria-label: Inferior articular process of L3 (dashed) — L3 下关节突（虚线）
text.tspan: Inferior articular process of L3 (dashed)
L3 下关节突（虚线）

text.aria-label: The joint surfaces face mostly sideways, so they — 关节面大多朝向侧方，
text.tspan: The joint surfaces face mostly sideways, so they
关节面大多朝向侧方，

text.aria-label: block rotation but let flexion and extension glide. — 所以挡住旋转，允许屈伸滑动。
text.tspan: block rotation but let flexion and extension glide.
所以挡住旋转，允许屈伸滑动。

text.aria-label: A: erector spinae and, deep to them, multifidus lie behind the axis; both extend the lumbar spine. Psoas major runs close to the axis and mainly flexes the hip. — A：竖脊肌及其深面的多裂肌位于运动轴后方，二者都使腰椎后伸。腰大肌靠近运动轴，主要屈髋。
text.tspan: A: erector spinae and, deep to them, multifidus lie behind the axis; both extend the lumbar spine. Psoas major runs close to the axis and mainly flexes the hip.
A：竖脊肌及其深面的多裂肌位于运动轴后方，二者都使腰椎后伸。腰大肌靠近运动轴，主要屈髋。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
